case.name: case
case.description: One case of a flow (e.g. a site), at /app/cases/:code: a header, then one tab per non-empty region among overview, tasks, activity and documents. The open tab is kept in the URL (?tab=).

regions.description: Above the tabs: the case's code, title, status and stage tracker.
Tasks tab: the case's open tasks and decision history.
Activity tab: what happened on the case.

standard.name: standard
standard.description: A department or overview page: an optional hero across the top, then the main column, with an aside column beside it when the aside has content (12 columns, or 8/4).

regions.description: Across the top of the page, e.g. a KPI strip.
The main column: inboxes, case tables.
A narrow column beside main; main takes the full width when it's empty.

1.name: case_activity
1.description: What happened on the case, oldest first: created, each stage started, done or closed, and each submitted task, with who and when. No form values.

1.name: case_fields
1.description: A case's start-form values, read-only, by section, as the user's level may see them. `sections` keeps only those section keys.

1.name: case_header
1.description: The top of a case page: the code, the title (the start field `title_field`, else the case's own title), its status, the start fields in `fields`, and the full stage tracker with a text label for every stage.

1.name: case_table
1.description: The cases of a flow, e.g. the Sites list: search, stage filter chips kept in the URL, status, days in the current stage and a mini stage tracker. `columns` picks from code, title, the flow's start field keys, stage, status, age, open_tasks and my_tasks; `stages` keeps only cases currently in those stages. Status shows Overdue in <stage> for a case longer in an open stage than its `sla_days`, and days in stage then counts that stage. A kpi_strip tile picked on the page shows the cases it counts instead of the stage filter chips (`stages` still applies). A row opens the case page.

1.name: case_tasks
1.description: The open tasks on a case the user can act on, each opening its form inline (`?task=<id>` opens one directly), and the case's decision history: task, who, outcome, comment, when.

1.name: kpi_strip
1.description: 2 to 4 count tiles over a flow's cases (`flow`, else the release's first, as case_table; within the `stages` of the page's case_table for that flow), e.g. on a department page:`open_cases`, `in_stage` (needs `stage`), `awaiting_me` (cases with a task for the user), `overdue` (longer in an open stage than its `sla_days`) and `done` (completed cases). `stage` narrows a tile to cases in that stage, or for `done` to cases past it; `label` replaces the default label. Picking a tile filters the page's case table to the cases it counts (kept in the URL); picking it again clears it.

1.name: task_inbox
1.description: Open tasks for the current user (mine) or their department (team), grouped by case. Each row opens the task on its case page.
